name: HM-Pool50
conditional_models: unchanged HM25 three heads and original T1 residual head
probability_pooling: uniform mean over all score-eligible links in same learned cluster at same window and step
cluster_distance: 1 - queue Jaccard on simultaneously observed cells; union count >= 20; complete linkage distance <= 0.05; inactive unsupported links singleton
fit_domains: same split released speed; heldout odd/even fits only other half; official fit all released days
selection_world: March strict entire-day holdout + February official-like holes joint state/physics
confirmation_world: April released pseudo holes only; no hidden truth
candidate_formula: 0.5 * shipped T1 speed + 0.5 * clip(shipped G2 speed + (1-p_pool)*free_residual + p_pool*queue_residual)
